title: THE BODY-BALL CENSUS — release facing · through-body flight · the GK loop · turn cost

world.composition: world 8 — `new Match({seed, teams, ...a4MatchFlags(8)})` + `armA4World(m, null, 8, poolT1DoseCells(L3-T1), poolPcDoseTable(PC-T1))`

definitions.misalignMeasure: the engine's own `kickMisalignment` = (1 − cos θ)/2 on the body's heading (src/sim/mechanics.ts:79)
definitions.facingTierRationale: quadrant geometry — θ = 45°, 90°, 135°; no invented constant
definitions.releaseFacingDirection: the ball's own horizontal velocity direction at the tick boundary after the release, de-rotated by the one tick of Magnus rotation `stepBall` applied; the residual error bound is published as `maxSpinRotationPerTickRad`
definitions.releaseFacingHeading: the striker's PRE-STEP heading — kicks fire in `executeAction` and at the two head-of-tick wind-up resolves, both BEFORE `physicsStep` writes the new heading
definitions.intentMisalign: the same measure against the direction of the intended TARGET body at the pre-step boundary (passes with a `pendingPass.targetGid` only)
definitions.releaseOutcome: the side of the NEXT body to touch the ball (the engine's own `lastTouch`/owner transition), else out-of-play / goal / no-touch-by-whistle
definitions.throughBodyScope: FREE ball (owner === null), phase === playing, body not sentOff, and the body is NOT the ball's `lastTouch` nor the tick's contact — the ball sitting inside the boot that just struck it is a self-contact artefact, not 球穿身
definitions.handlerContactDefinition: `ball.lastTouch` changed this step, or ownership passed to a body that did not own it last tick
definitions.causeLadderRule: evaluated in the listed order, one cell per body-tick; the residual `rollOrClaimOrder` is the blind/speed roll, the oriented-shell screening, or another claim winning the tick
definitions.fastBallSplitRationale: the engine's own trivially-trapped cut in `attemptFirstTouch` (`speed <= 6` returns a clean touch unconditionally)
definitions.gkChannelRule: the keeper's own ACTION label at the pre-step boundary; `punt` = `LoftedPass` while `gkDistributing`
definitions.bounceBackDefinition: the RELEASING keeper owns the ball again after his own release
definitions.bounceBackWindowRationale: 2 × the engine's own lofted-flight cap tMax = 2 s (src/sim/mechanics.ts:476) — one lofted round trip, out and back
definitions.turnoverWindowRationale: the engine's own arrival law `L3_DEFENCE_WINDOW_S = sqrt(2·CB_TACKLE_RADIUS/ACCEL) + π/TURN_RATE` (src/ai/defenceBook.ts), i.e. the widest window the engine itself says a defender needs to arrive and challenge
definitions.turnoverMeasuredFrom: the TEAMMATE's first touch, not the keeper's release

binning.percentileConvention: a percentile face reports the UPPER EDGE of the bin the cumulative count crosses (the honest coarse read from stored bins)
